summary: AMTD Digital Inc. via its subsidiary AMTD IDEA Group filed a Form 6-K announcing the successful acquisition of the Dao by Dorsett Hornsey Hotel for US$30 million (all-cash, no external financing) and a definitive agreement to acquire Hornsey Town Hall for US$33 million. The registrant is the acquirer; no board recommendation or advisor is named. The hotel acquisition closed immediately; the Town Hall closing is subject to customary conditions and expected shortly. Watch for completion of the Town Hall transaction and integration of hospitality assets.
